title: FloatBook
tagline: Every naira at the counter, accounted for.
summary: Back-office software for Nigerian POS and agent-banking businesses. It replaces the notebook and WhatsApp group: every transaction, the cash and wallet float at each outlet, the end-of-day count, reversals, and the owner’s numbers, live.
problem: POS owners run their business from a notebook and WhatsApp messages. Cash goes missing, failed transactions are forgotten, and the owner can’t see today’s profit without being there.
note: Honest note from the README: FloatBook does not connect to Moniepoint, OPay or Palmpay. Data comes from entry at the counter and imported provider statements, through an adapter layer ready for real integrations.
features: A one-thumb keypad: charges, fees and profit worked out as you type
Works offline and sends entries when the network returns, never twice
Cash and wallet float for every drawer, with low-balance alerts
A blind end-of-day count that closes the day for good
Each failed transaction opens a case with a 72-hour target
Import provider statements and see what doesn’t match
Flags duplicates, large amounts and after-hours entries
A double-entry ledger checked by the database; nothing is edited in place
shots: Landing page with the counter keypad
The owner’s dashboard and what needs attention
Cash and wallet float at every outlet
why: I wanted to build the unglamorous back office a cash business actually depends on, for the devices its owners actually use. FloatBook had to hold up on a cheap phone with patchy signal — offline included — rather than assume a laptop and good broadband.
hard: Every figure sits on a double-entry ledger checked by the database itself. Nothing is edited or deleted in place; mistakes are voided or reversed and both sides stay.
Entries are kept on the phone when the network drops and sent once it returns, never twice.
A day that closes for good
The blind end-of-day count closes the day permanently; any difference needs a supervisor’s approval.
2FA and passkeys with Laravel Fortify, four roles, and static analysis at Larastan level 7.
